text.content:
If your eyes aren't Kiroshis, why did you get new eyes?

Industry: Cyberoptics: design and manufacture
In Night City: The Kiroshi Campus in Charter Hill; outlets all over the city
Known for: The market leader in optics; sponsors the pop group Us Cracks

The industry leader in cybernetic eyes. Kiroshi's sponsorship of the Japanese pop group Us Cracks has made it a favorite with young buyers around the world.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.23
